convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow BERT checkpoint to a PyTorch model using config json and checkpoint path
build_bert_config_from_json: build a BertConfig object from a JSON configuration file for BERT model architecture
load_tf_weights_in_bert: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch BERT model for pre-training
create_bert_for_pretraining: create a BertForPreTraining PyTorch model instance from a BertConfig configuration
save_pytorch_model_state_dict: save a PyTorch model state dictionary to a file using torch.save
